logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var logMessage = { userId: vars.userId, error: error.description } import buildLog from dwl::log --- buildLog("ERROR","Profile fetch failed.",logMessage,vars.correlationId , vars.flowName)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "DAILY-INSIGHT-503", message: "Unable to retrieve complete user profile data.", correlationId: correlationId, timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"}, originLayer: "process" }

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json var logMessage = { userId: vars.userId, error: error.description, attr: attributes, summaryWearable: vars.summaryWearable } import buildLog from dwl::log --- buildLog("ERROR","Daily Insight Error.",logMessage,vars.correlationId , vars.flowName)]
